context: Evaluates correct use of Fastify's in-process HTTP injection API for testing. The candidate must build a Fastify app and use inject() to send requests and assert on responses without starting a real server. Focus is entirely on proper use of the Fastify testing primitives.

checklist.name: inject() usage
checklist.description: Uses app.inject() (or fastify.inject()) to send requests instead of a real HTTP client or starting a listener

checklist.name: InjectOptions format
checklist.description: Passes the correct InjectOptions object to inject() with at minimum a method and url field

checklist.name: Response assertions
checklist.description: Asserts on the response statusCode and on the parsed JSON payload (json() or JSON.parse(body))

checklist.name: app.ready() / await
checklist.description: Calls app.ready() (or await app.listen()) before injecting requests, ensuring plugins are fully loaded

checklist.name: app.close() teardown
checklist.description: Calls app.close() in an after/teardown hook to cleanly shut down the app after each test or test suite
